    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ApiNotReadyException
    A write operation was requested before Companies could perform it.
    CancellableWithReason
    An event that stops an action when it is cancelled, and tells the player who triggered the action why.
    CompaniesApi
    Entry point of the Companies API.
    CompanyApi
    Reads companies and adds members to them.
    CompanyCreateEvent
    A company was founded.
    CompanyDisbandEvent
    A company was disbanded.
    CompanyEvent<Company>
    Base of the events about a company.
    CompanyJoinEvent
    A player joined a company: by an open join, an accepted invite or application, or through the API.
    CompanyKickEvent
    A member was removed from a company by another member.
    CompanyLeaveEvent
    A member left a company or was removed from it.
    CompanyLevelChangeEvent
    The level of a company changed.
    CompanyLevelDownEvent
    The level of a company decreased.
    CompanyLevelUpEvent
    The level of a company increased.
    CompanyOwnerTransferEvent
    The ownership of a company passed to another member, by the owner or by an admin.
    CompanyPermission
    A permission of a member within a company.
    CompanyProfileEditEvent
    A member changed the description, tag, colour or join mode of a company.
    CompanyProvider<C>
    An event that involves a company.
    CompanyRenameEvent
    A company was renamed, by its owner or by an admin.
    CreateOrderResult
    The outcome of OrderApi.create(OrderRequest): the created order or why it was not created.
    CreateOrderResult.Created
    The order was created.
    CreateOrderResult.Rejected
    The order was not created and nothing was charged.
    HistoryOutcome
    How an order ended, as recorded in the order history.
    ICompanyLevel
    A configured company level.
    ICompanyMember
    A member of a company with their permissions in it.
    ICompanyProfile
    A company with its members and profile details.
    ICompanyRank
    A company at its place in a ranking.
    ICompanyStats
    Statistics of a company.
    IContentPart
    The share one worker delivered to a line of an order.
    IDeliveredStack
    Items a worker delivered to one line of an order, stored exactly as they were delivered.
    IDraftLine
    One line of an IOrderDraft.
    IFullOrder
    An order with its lines.
    ILevelRequirement
    What a company needs to reach a level.
    ILevelSettings
    What a company on a level may do.
    IMaterialPrice
    The prices of one item of a material in past orders.
    IMemberStats
    What one worker contributed to a company in a time range.
    IOrderContent
    One line of an order: an item and the amount and total price requested for it.
    IOrderDraft
    An order that is about to be created, as listeners of PreOrderCreateEvent see and change it.
    ISimpleCompany
    A company without its members.
    ISimpleOrder
    An order without its lines.
    ItemsReturnedEvent
    Items were put into a player's returned items, which the player picks up with /order collect.
    ItemsReturnedEvent.Reason
    Why items were returned to a player.
    ItemsReturnedEvent.ReturnedStack
    Returned items of one kind.
    JoinMode
    How players can become members of a company.
    JoinResult
    Outcome of adding a player to a company.
    OrderAcceptEvent
    A company accepted an order and claimed it.
    OrderApi
    Reads and creates orders.
    OrderCanceledEvent
    A company aborted a claimed order; the order is open again for other companies.
    OrderCreatedEvent
    An order was created and saved, by a player or through the API.
    OrderDeliveryEvent
    A worker delivered items to an order.
    OrderDoneEvent
    All items of an order are delivered and the owner can receive it.
    OrderEvent<Order>
    Base of the events about an existing order.
    OrderExpiredEvent
    A company did not deliver a claimed order in time; the order is open again for other companies.
    OrderLineRequest
    One line of an OrderRequest: the requested item, how many of it and the price of one.
    OrderPaymentEvent
    A worker is about to be paid their share of a completed order.
    OrderProvider<O>
    An event that involves an order.
    OrderReceivedEvent
    The owner received the items of a delivered order.
    OrderRemovedEvent
    An order was deleted before it was delivered: removed because nobody accepted it, cancelled by its owner, or deleted by an admin.
    OrderRemovedEvent.Reason
    Why an order was deleted.
    OrderRequest
    An order to create with OrderApi.create(OrderRequest).
    OrderRequest.Builder
    Builds an OrderRequest.
    OrderSource
    Where the creation of an order came from.
    OrderState
    The life cycle of an order.
    OwnerProvider
    An event that involves the owner of an order.
    PlayerApi
    Reads and changes the per-player data of Companies.
    PlayerProvider<P>
    An event that involves a player.
    PreCompanyCreateEvent
    A player is about to found a company.
    PreOrderAcceptEvent
    A member of a company is about to accept an order for the company.
    PreOrderCreateEvent
    An order is about to be created, by a player or through the API.
    RankingApi
    Reads the company ranking that /company top shows.
    RejectReason
    Why an order was not created.
    TimeRange
    The time a ranking or a statistic covers.
    TopOrder
    What the company ranking is sorted by.
